notes: These are normalized CI budgets, not Ayn Thor FPS targets.
Every scenario is divided by same-run idle timing to reduce hosted-runner variance.
The 20 percent allowance is applied by the guard before failure.

full_world_mesh_ms is reported as a metric, not a budget: hosted runs of one build measured 65699, 144472 and 240317 ms at near-identical idle medians, so no duration threshold near that spread is stable. The old absolute 240000 ms budget failed at 240317 ms on runner variance.
full_mesh_wait_cap_ms is the streaming cap the guard asserts: camera-driven meshing must finish the valley inside it. It bounds the shard and is not a duration threshold.
Calibrate these budgets to measured healthy-run values after the current Thor section-placement regression is repaired.
